absolute-domination.replacement: NEW one live Absolute controller per target across casters. Only an actually admitted new control replaces the old same-spell component; a saved/immune/guard-blocked attempt does not. Old and different-identity effects retain their exact scope. Actual concentration loss, source-owned removal, matching save, recipient terminal ending or original maximum ends control. Loss of same-plane communication merely prevents a new order; it does not pause the clock or bank one.
absolute-domination.saves: KEEP one WIS at END of EACH ACTUAL affected target turn, including a genuinely source-authorized inserted full turn and an affected current turn, while this application still exists, even if control is suppressed. This explicit native exception applies only to its ending save, not orders, recharge, regular budgets or periodic ticks. A successful save ends this application and its pending order. No damage-triggered save is added. Original maximum is establishment+60elapsed seconds. The separate companion/fallback save bridge is labelled NEW and is not evidence of an extra turn. A genuine inserted-turn positive case stays held unless the complete granting source and legal acquisition actually exist.

command-reality.conduct: NEW the sentence may direct meaningful ordinary movement, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, ordinary Attack and actual free/object Actions, including actions contrary to ordinary political preference; it is stronger than one-word Command and need not be advice the target finds reasonable. It cannot force spells/RP, charge/recharge/per-rest use, optional or special ammunition, consumption, permanent property transfer, self-harm, knowing suicide, private protected disclosures or oath violation. No BA,Reaction or separately granted extra Action is taken. Actual ordinary skill/attack outcomes are rolled normally. Target chooses safe legal details of the stated task; no guaranteed success or caster truth diagnosis. Steps use each real opportunity's remaining budgets; compatible steps may share one act, a blocked contested Action supplies no second Action. A genuine temporary delay may wait within the unchanged deadline; actual impossibility ends it.
command-reality.ending: NEW one pending Command Reality task per target across casters, replacing only on successful establishment of a meaningful new task. A failed attempt leaves the old task and history. Suppression disables task enforcement but preserves completion/progress, hard history and deadline; no suppressed step executes later for free. At expiry or source ending drop only the remaining mandate, preserving actual acts, payments, ownership and memories.
command-reality.persistence: NEW resolve the Instantaneous ambiguity as establishment of one nonconcentration task instruction, ending at actual completion, established impossibility or establishment+60elapsed seconds. No repeat or damage-triggered save is added. One initial WIS, success nothing; failure establishes only a legally meaningful original task under real defenses. If any necessary step commandeers a whole ordinary Action, reserve hard control now. If blocked, only an independently meaningful originally declared soft task can survive; no later promotion to hard control. Necessary unavailable prohibited resources make the task invalid, not a permission to wait for or acquire them magically.
command-reality.sentence: KEEP one creature,one sentence,WIS resistance,Action120ft/V,S,F/base26. NEW the target must actually hear and understand the spoken sentence at resolution. One coherent bounded task may contain ordered substeps and one objective stated stopping condition using identified referents; conjunctions do not create unrelated tasks, recursive orders, an indefinite obey-me relationship or a hidden inventory query. There is no invented word-count cap. Caster declares the entire immutable sentence before payment; a Ready preserves it while selecting its actual target at release.

dominate-legion.admission: KEEP up toTEN simultaneous creatures and minute concentration. NEW one to ten distinct perceived creatures within120ft/LoE, fixed before hidden outcomes. Resolve the printed Automatic-or-opposed gap with an explicitly selected initial WIS per target, as AG9-Q09 optionA; this is spell-local resistance authorship, not recovered native wording. No CR/type cap and no generic voluntary-fail rule. Success/prevention admits nothing and opens no replacement slot. Each failed recipient independently admits the non-Charmed hard component and spends its actual source-character guard once. All ten may genuinely be controlled when all ten independently qualify.
dominate-legion.companions: Use only each actual original-owner attached phase and the common companion bridge. Two listed companions of one owner still share that owner's one structural command/offense allowance; a live pending reservation belongs to its real companion/phase. The second body cannot steal a consumed reservation or create another owner BA. Default movement/Dodge follows the real chassis, not the dominator's class. Outside-initiative transition preserves spent budgets. No missing authoritative CR is relevant because this spell introduces no CR gate; missing actual body/attack/phase content remains a hold.
dominate-legion.ending: Select AG9-Q11 optionB: NO repeated escape save and no damage-triggered save are printed, and none is added. Each recipient ends independently on exact removal, recipient terminal ending, successful same-spell controller replacement or common concentration/60-second maximum. A released recipient never frees a retargeting slot. One live Legion controller per recipient across casters; failed new attempts replace nothing. Same caster's new concentration already ends the previous entire Legion before resolution. No ending refunds the hard record or commands an immediate replacement turn.
dominate-legion.orders: Use the exact common rank9 opportunity order contract separately for every admitted recipient through ONE concentrating cast. No caster Action/BA is added per order, no arbitrary one-functional-recipient limit. Different targets may receive different orders at their own actual opportunities; every target uses only its own ordinary budget and legal known capability/resource history. Extra turns supply no new Legion order. Earlier valid mandatory instructions retain actual priority; no instruction or body lends an Action to another.

erase-soul.admission: KEEP the caster's Core Action120ft/V,S,F/base26. The parenthetical no action describes the victim's inability and no-cost early save, not free casting. NEW one perceived creature/LoE. Initial establishment is automatic under the Core Automatic-or-opposed field and actual defenses; do NOT add an initial save. Wisdom is used only at the expressly selected early-ending checkpoints. Nonconcentration for its original three hostile target-round deadlines.
erase-soul.clock: NEW one WIS at every affected regular target END including an affected current END, plus the explicitly separate attached-phase/END-only bridge when required. Success ends both still-owned components. Maximum is the third FUTURE regular target END under the accepted hostile clock; an in-progress current END can offer an early save but is not one of those three future markers. At the final marker resolve its scheduled early save then maximum expiry. Outside initiative use application+18seconds maximum with the bounded END-only transition, not a new action cycle. No extra-turn or damage save is added. Suppression and independently scoped immunity preserve the same checkpoints and guard history.
erase-soul.components: NEW two separately admitted components. ES-DENIAL is hard control: actual Incapacitated plus no voluntary movement,free object interaction or intentional speech while operative. It grants no paralysis,automatic STR/DEX failure,loss of awareness,critical-hit permission or death. Its Incapacitated consequence really ends old concentration; removal does not restore it. ES-IDENTITY is a soft subjective overlay: the target cannot recognize its own autobiographical identity or link personal-history facts to itself, while baseline memories, factual perceptions, class knowledge, capabilities, legal person, resources and soul records remain intact. It supplies no alternate person, stolen knowledge or compelled allegiance. If denial is initially blocked, eligible identity loss alone may remain without gaining a future hard component.
erase-soul.restoration: NEW independent casts retain components and deadlines; identical restrictions do not gain numerical magnitude. One cast's save never removes another cast's component. End this source to expose baseline self-recognition plus all genuine experiences formed meanwhile; do not erase recent acts, restore old concentration or manufacture missed Actions. The name grants no soul erasure,ordinary death,Hunt finality,corruption removal or resurrection veto.

overwhelming-presence.behavior: NEW the choice remains until the next specified choice checkpoint or suppression/ending. Choosing submission restricts the stated hostile conduct but preserves other legal Actions,normal movement and posture budgets; choosing fear uses only real Frightened effects. Damage grants no new save or choice. A suppressed choice is not enforced and its ordinary Actions remain subject to independent effects; resumption uses the last choice until the next real checkpoint. Calm Emotions suppresses only fear, not the alternative submission record. Initially blocked mental influence creates no later choice. No hard-denial claim is made for this expressly soft conduct.

Execution/invalidity/impossibility/suppression/priority loss/budget starvation all end that opportunity's order. No carry, bank, replay or retry on an extra turn. Controller replacement invalidates old pending orders and grants no immediate new opportunity.
sharedSelections.outsideInitiative: NEW Absolute/Legion ordinary independent creatures use the exact bounded six-second control cycle as an expressly local extension: one shared target behavior budget across concurrent applications, no extra encounter Reaction/recharge/resource refresh. Establish initiative before hostile execution. Existing source maximum deadlines remain. Attached companions use only their original chassis phases, never the independent creature cycle.

originalQuestionUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose persistence,dispel/antimagic behavior,contrary-evidence recovery and exact memory-restoration interface. A short one-turn duration would materially reduce the printed premise and needs justification. No unsupported universal curse tag or automatic RemoveCurse cure. Preserve original identity and prior memories once; duplicate/replaced overlays cannot overwrite the true restoration baseline or rewrite earlier independent memories.

rewrite-loyalty.cause: KEEP initial CHA and the target's belief that it has ALWAYS SERVED YOUR CAUSE. NEW one perceived creature within120ft/LoE. Before payment identify one concrete finite cause the caster actually pursues,its stated objective and actual known referents. No undefined universal 'obey anything I later say',hidden affiliation test or replacement cause after results. On failed CHA,admit an actual mental-belief component under its own defenses; it is not Charmed,Stunned or a direct command permission.
rewrite-loyalty.conduct: NEW the target/controller makes real decisions using that altered conviction: may voluntarily protect known cause assets,prioritize its stated duties and cooperate with independently known supporters. Actual personal safety,conscience,oaths,other beliefs,capabilities and ordinary budgets still constrain decisions; no automatic instruction/secret disclosure/forced spell/Action is granted. A demanded whole Action would need a separately lawful control source and hard guard,not a loophole through the word belief. Actual resulting acts have their ordinary institutional/reputation/oath consequences; the cast itself changes none of those objective records,alignment,class access,ownership or completed service achievements.
rewrite-loyalty.persistence: NEW Core Instantaneous establishes one continuing NONCONCENTRATION indefinite overlay until exact source removal,recipient terminal identity ending or successful same-spell replacement. It is not a curse and Remove Curse is not automatically authorized. Mere contrary evidence does not add an unprinted save or automatically dispel the strong belief; the target remembers seeing the evidence and reconciles it subjectively. Current Mind Blank suppresses the active belief expression without deleting it or restoring/removing unrelated completed memory edits. Actual source-qualified dispel ends this overlay and re-exposes original interpretation plus all genuine later experiences; another memory restoration must prove its own scope before use.
rewrite-loyalty.replacement: NEW one operative Rewrite Loyalty cause per target across casters. A successfully admitted later overlay replaces the old; a saved,invalid or defended attempt replaces nothing. Keep one unchanged true baseline and every independent subsequent actual memory; never snapshot an already-altered belief as true past. Suppression does not permit two active causes or rewrite the baseline. Ending the latest overlay does not resurrect the replaced one. The target retains memories of real acts committed while influenced; no asset,crime,promise,oath consequence or third-party memory is undone.
rewrite-loyalty.subjective: NEW preserve immutable original autobiographical records and actual identity. Overlay a settled subjective conviction of lifelong service to the declared cause,including first-person identification with that service. Existing remembered events remain accessible as genuine memory records; incompatible memories are interpreted as past confusion,cover or failure in service,without manufacturing new events,dates,meetings,secret facts or other people's assent. The target knows no new cause membership or history beyond actual information. The spell changes belief meaningfully,not just a friendliness score,but does not edit external truth.

questionDispositions.justification: Preserves every native clause and actual source/access row; ambiguous operational fields are selected NEW within these named identities only. Source feasibility is not inferred from a name, label, profile silhouette or arithmetic pass.

originalQuestionUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Belief in lifelong service can affect behavior but does not expressly grant direct orders,alignment changes,real faction standing or oath immunity.
originalQuestionUnchanged.options: A: genuine target decision-making from the specified altered belief with no automatic domination. B: a precisely authored additional command component,with its admission and action limits.
originalQuestionUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A while making behavioral consequences concrete and useful: how duties,recognized allies,contrary causes and personal boundaries are evaluated. External reputation/membership,Paladin oaths and actual class access stay their real records unless expressly changed by a separate rule. Genuine resulting acts still have ordinary consequences. Resolve multiple casters/causes,immunity,restoration and post-expiry knowledge without silently granting protected secrets or bypassing control admission through the label belief.

erase-soul.admission: KEEP the caster's Core Action120ft/V,S,F/base26. The parenthetical no action describes the victim's inability and no-cost early save, not free casting. NEW one perceived creature/LoE. Initial establishment is automatic under the Core Automatic-or-opposed field and actual defenses; do NOT add an initial save. Wisdom is used only at the expressly selected early-ending checkpoints. Nonconcentration for its original three hostile target-round deadlines.
erase-soul.clock: NEW one WIS at every affected regular target END including an affected current END, plus the explicitly separate attached-phase/END-only bridge when required. Success ends both still-owned components. Maximum is the third FUTURE regular target END under the accepted hostile clock; an in-progress current END can offer an early save but is not one of those three future markers. At the final marker resolve its scheduled early save then maximum expiry. Outside initiative use application+18seconds maximum with the bounded END-only transition, not a new action cycle. No extra-turn or damage save is added. Suppression and independently scoped immunity preserve the same checkpoints and guard history.
erase-soul.components: NEW two separately admitted components. ES-DENIAL is hard control: actual Incapacitated plus no voluntary movement,free object interaction or intentional speech while operative. It grants no paralysis,automatic STR/DEX failure,loss of awareness,critical-hit permission or death. Its Incapacitated consequence really ends old concentration; removal does not restore it. ES-IDENTITY is a soft subjective overlay: the target cannot recognize its own autobiographical identity or link personal-history facts to itself, while baseline memories, factual perceptions, class knowledge, capabilities, legal person, resources and soul records remain intact. It supplies no alternate person, stolen knowledge or compelled allegiance. If denial is initially blocked, eligible identity loss alone may remain without gaining a future hard component.
erase-soul.restoration: NEW independent casts retain components and deadlines; identical restrictions do not gain numerical magnitude. One cast's save never removes another cast's component. End this source to expose baseline self-recognition plus all genuine experiences formed meanwhile; do not erase recent acts, restore old concentration or manufacture missed Actions. The name grants no soul erasure,ordinary death,Hunt finality,corruption removal or resurrection veto.

overwhelming-presence.behavior: NEW the choice remains until the next specified choice checkpoint or suppression/ending. Choosing submission restricts the stated hostile conduct but preserves other legal Actions,normal movement and posture budgets; choosing fear uses only real Frightened effects. Damage grants no new save or choice. A suppressed choice is not enforced and its ordinary Actions remain subject to independent effects; resumption uses the last choice until the next real checkpoint. Calm Emotions suppresses only fear, not the alternative submission record. Initially blocked mental influence creates no later choice. No hard-denial claim is made for this expressly soft conduct.
overwhelming-presence.choice: NEW on failure and at each subsequent actual regular START while exposed, the target/controller chooses SUBMISSION or FEAR at no extra Action. A midturn application chooses immediately but creates no second START. Submission is outward conduct: lower/tilt the body or another physically available deferential gesture, brief spoken praise if actually able to speak, and refrain from willingly attacking or openly obstructing the caster while that choice remains. It does not require kneeling,Prone,an unavailable anatomy,full Action loss,true religious belief,confession or permanent service. If no genuine deferential body gesture is possible, submission is unavailable rather than a new punitive condition. Fear applies the exact native Frightened relation to this caster. The target may choose an ineffective FEAR when genuinely fear-immune; immunity never forces worship.
overwhelming-presence.ending: NEW each independent field preserves its own first-exposure history,choice,owner and deadline. Compatible soft restrictions coexist; no one source converts another's ineffective fear into worship. Concentration loss,exact removal or original maximum ends matching records. Departures do not create an encounter reset,faith change,deity identity,objective reputation edit or new initiative turn.
overwhelming-presence.field: KEEP plural creatures,120ft casting range,minute concentration,appropriate save. NEW fixed30ft-radius sphere centered at a perceived point within120ft/LoE, lasting60elapsed seconds. All creature bodies intersecting the actual sphere with center LoE and actual ability to perceive the caster by ordinary sight or hearing are eligible, including self/allies; no selective hidden roster. Solid total cover or inability to perceive the caster prevents exposure. One initial WIS at first eligible exposure; success protects against this cast for its remainder, failure records the choice application. Leaving/cover suppresses it, reentry resumes without a new save. No recurring escape save is added.

perfect-mesmerize.admission: KEEP one creature,Stunned,silent,defenseless and full-duration-unless-damaged. NEW resolve Core Instantaneous as establishment of a nonconcentration60elapsed-second application on one perceived creature within120ft/LoE. Use automatic initial application subject to real defenses and hard guard; add neither initial nor repeated escape saves. Other genuine universal/source endings remain possible. This useful finite continuation and no-concentration choice are explicit local authorship.
perfect-mesmerize.components: NEW PM-STUN is the exact native Stunned condition, including Incapacitated,immobility,faltering-speech limit,automatic STR/DEX save failure and attackers' advantage; it is not paralysis or automatic critical damage. Claim its hard guard only when actually admitted. PM-SILENCE independently prevents intentional vocal sound/speech,so it is stronger than faltering speech but creates no deafness or area silence. PM-DEFENSE independently suppresses active Guard/Dodge benefits and prohibits new Guard,Dodge,Interpose or defensive Reaction commitments. It does not remove armor,cover,passive/numerical AC,resistance,immunity,already-paid reactions or all ordinary Actions. Exact Stun-only immunity prevents only PM-STUN; the other printed clauses remain if separately eligible. Initially blocked hard control never appears later. Baseline concentration truly ended by Stunned is never restored.
perfect-mesmerize.continuity: NEW qualifying damage ends the underlying application even while all its components are suppressed. No damage means full original lifetime,not a hidden saving-throw escape. Independent applications keep exact components and common break linkage; a given damage event ends each qualifying matching application once. A removed component never resumes; a suppressed still-live one may resume without new admission/history. A fresh Mind Blank can suppress mental components but cannot restore already-lost concentration,Actions or source-bound tempHP. Death/terminal identity ending and actual dispel end the source without refund.
perfect-mesmerize.damageBreak: NEW common break at the post-recipient-damage/life checkpoint, before future voluntary events: qualifying damage is positive actual numeric temporaryHP absorbed plus ordinaryHP lost by THIS recipient from a real damage packet, excluding overkill and pure HP/resource costs. Fully prevented damage,an attack miss,a hit with zero actual loss,or damage redirected entirely away does not qualify. A positive incoming transferred share does qualify under its actual no-second-mitigation rules. A positive nominal packet stopped at a floor with zero tempHP/normalHP loss does not qualify; exact floor source remains required for a positive fixture. The triggering attack uses its original defense/hit/critical snapshot; cleanup never rerolls it. Perform Wounds/life and actual concentration consequences once under their own source before ending every surviving component of each affected Mesmerize application.

originalQuestionUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: These sources combine separately meaningful identity belief, denial, outward conduct, silence, defense and damage-break clauses. One generic mental or Stunned flag loses native distinctions.
originalQuestionUnchanged.request: Provide separate actual and subjective state records with complete original memory preservation. Show Erase Soul identity overlay and denial ending together or separately under the selected rule, genuine worship-versus-fear choice including fear immunity and nonkneeling anatomy, all three Mesmerize components with exact actual-damage break checkpoint, and useful lifelong-service belief without fabricated institutional history. Existing source-qualified immunity/Calm Emotions/True Seeing/restoration affects only its authorized components; no lost concentration, spent action or prior memory is silently restored.

sharedSelections.authority: KEEP the exact current native cards and every classAccess row. All nine use Action,120ft,V/S/F,rank9/base26RP and minimum class level17. Eight are Wizard-only Enchantment; Prophecy Fulfilled additionally has actual Cleric Divination access. No school, class, learned matrix, focus, payment or component exemption follows from a spell name. Current authority is770 applied/78 pending/0 accepted-unapplied,494 standalone procedures,173 interfaces. This is NEW spell-local authored completion, not a global rule amendment. Historical recommendations and pending comparison labels are preserved but do not override the current index or exact accepted comparison scope.
sharedSelections.commitment: KEEP actual perception, range, line of effect, bodily components, class/repertoire/preparation and pre-cast resource eligibility. Declare mode, task/cause/instruction and fixed policy before payment or at paid Ready preparation; never revise after hidden eligibility or RNG. Spend the actual ordinary Action,26RP plus any real surcharge and actual class cadence, displacing incompatible concentration at commitment. Countering or later prevention retains all paid costs and lost prior concentration. Ready uses the exact accepted paid-preparation/target-at-release/real Reaction contract, no second cast/payment or counter window. Held nonconcentration spells require concentration only until their real release. An invalid release may wait only under the existing Ready contract, before its original next-own-START expiry.
sharedSelections.companions: NEW expressly extend the exact reviewed Dominate Beast/Dominate Person chassis bridge only to the named commands here. An owner-attached creature has no invented independent turn. Issue at its real original-owner regular attached phase only. Keep original body/owner, stats, slot, lifetime, finite resources, command and offense allowances. A valid domination order can use the original owner's available structural command/offense allowance without charging an unwilling owner's BA or RP. A paid pending reservation can be reused only for the same companion in the same phase; no stealing another companion's reservation and no refund of a paid owner BA/offense. If no domination order is valid, an already-valid owner instruction may execute; otherwise the actual chassis default applies. Missing phase creates neither command nor action. The new Absolute/Erase END-only save bridge is one save after each real ordinary attached phase, or an expressly selected6-second END-only fallback while no such phase exists; it grants no turn, budget, recharge, death save or offense. Preserve next unresolved marker across transitions and no replay.
sharedSelections.defensesAndEnding: KEEP component-specific defenses: native Charmed immunity has no effect on a component that is not Charmed; Stunned immunity covers only actual Stunned. Current Mind Blank's accessible Abjuration route prevents new mind-affecting spell components before establishment and suppresses existing covered live components without erasing records. Calm Emotions suppresses actual Frightened only, not identity, silence, stun, allegiance or generic control. True Seeing does not restore these non-illusion mental changes. Suppression runs original deadlines, costs and expressly required saves; missed commands/packets are not queued. NEW each ongoing application is independently perceivable as an aura with actual Arcane Sight and addressable by real source-qualified dispel; no aura reveals the target's private memories. Actual Wizard Arch Dispel remains rank3/3RP/Action60ft/recharge2/INT+PB vs10+rank, not rank5. Source-owned removal clears only its remaining components and orders. An actual terminal body/identity ending ends recipient control; no soul destruction, Hunt result, revival or institutional correction is implied.
sharedSelections.hardGuard: KEEP the existing combined source-character/target/encounter hard-denial guard across spells, class features and companions. Absolute/Dominate Legion control, a Command Reality task necessarily consuming a whole ordinary Action, Erase Soul denial, Perfect Mesmerize Stunned and Prophecy's whole-Action mandate claim it once on actual legal establishment, never at each later opportunity. Initial prevention creates no dormant/banked hard component. Suppression, priority loss, replacement and removal never refund the claim. The actually printed independent identity, silence and defenseless components may remain when their hard sibling is blocked. This supplies no invented soft fallback. Overwhelming submission as defined below does not remove an Action; Realm changes a recipient of an existing attack or blocks a voluntary movement segment, not a whole Action or new commanded Action. Those two exact functions do not claim hard denial. No global mental flag or type-derived immunity is invented.
sharedSelections.instructionArbitration: NEW explicitly bind only these spells' actual mandatory instructions to the accepted Compelled Budget Arbitration: earlier valid instruction timestamp, then recorded application order and stable mechanical ID. Absolute/Legion opportunity orders use their actual issuance timestamp; Command Reality/Prophecy use successful establishment. Compatible acts may satisfy multiple instructions once; an impossible earlier instruction claims no budget. Incompatible later instructions receive no extra budget and cannot delete an earlier mandate. Same-spell replacement requires an actually established new component. A failed different-caster attempt does not replace the old; the same caster's incompatible concentration nevertheless already ended at new commitment. No priority choice after an outcome.
sharedSelections.orders: NEW common order object for Absolute/Legion: at the target's future regular START, after mandatory start processing, a conscious unsuppressed same-plane controller may issue one one-way mental order for that opportunity at no additional action cost. Initial120ft is not a maintained tether; actual mental-channel denial still applies, with no remote senses, location, inventory or feedback. No order for an already-started turn and no advance pending queue. The order may use current ordinary movement, one ordinary Action and one free interaction. An ordinary Attack keeps its actual native sequence; normal ammunition is paid. Explicit NEW broader rank9 choice: one specifically identified, previously observed known/prepared ordinary Action spell/class technique may be required, paying its actual RP and cadence; no unknown capability probe, optional modifier, recharge/per-rest/consumable charge, HP/soul sacrifice, optional extra-action source or unavailable component may be compelled. This does not extend lower-rank Dominate Person/Mass Dominate permissions. No BA, Reaction or separately granted extra Action is controlled. No forced belief, secret extraction, permanent ownership surrender, knowing suicide or oath violation is part of an order. The target supplies safe legal details from its actual knowledge; if none exists, expire the order with ordinary agency under surviving effects. Execution/invalidity/impossibility/suppression/priority loss/budget starvation all end that opportunity's order. No carry, bank, replay or retry on an extra turn. Controller replacement invalidates old pending orders and grants no immediate new opportunity.
sharedSelections.outsideInitiative: NEW Absolute/Legion ordinary independent creatures use the exact bounded six-second control cycle as an expressly local extension: one shared target behavior budget across concurrent applications, no extra encounter Reaction/recharge/resource refresh. Establish initiative before hostile execution. On transition carry already-issued order and spent movement/Action/interaction into the first actual regular turn; ordinary actual START processing still occurs, but no second control START or behavior refill. Existing source maximum deadlines remain. One-shot Command Reality and Prophecy use actual ordinary task/opportunity permissions with the same no-duplicate-budget principle, not a new repeated combat turn generator. Attached companions use only their original chassis phases, never the independent creature cycle.
sharedSelections.qualifications: All cases are finite authored data, not observed campaign events. Declared bodies, terrain, language, history, ordinary loose objects and consent are conditional inputs, not new creatures, items, powers or campaign facts. Missing operative profiles, genuine extra-turn grants, mandatory geometry or cosmological predicates remain narrow whole-case/branch holds. All inherited source/access/content and WC188-B01/B02 holds remain. Static review and static full-state replay grant no implementation/runtime, human-play/playtest, balance, cosmology, domain-closure or release approval. No canonical files are edited and no application is claimed.
sharedSelections.state: Record immutable cast/application IDs, original actual caster/class/school/rank/DC, paid history, actual recipient IDs, source-relative deadlines, separate established components, immunity/suppression sources, hard history, issued/expired instructions, actual budgets, pending commitments and exactly-once event IDs. Actual identity, baseline autobiographical records, known class/repertoire, HP/tempHP/Wounds, equipment/custody, institutional records and independent sources are separate from subjective overlays. An audit state reveals no new player knowledge. New memories of actual events append separately; cleanup never discards them or restores spent resources, old concentration or old positions.

Steps use each real opportunity's remaining budgets; compatible steps may share one act, a blocked contested Action supplies no second Action. A genuine temporary delay may wait within the unchanged deadline; actual impossibility ends it.
command-reality.ending: NEW one pending Command Reality task per target across casters, replacing only on successful establishment of a meaningful new task. A failed attempt leaves the old task and history. Suppression disables task enforcement but preserves completion/progress, hard history and deadline; no suppressed step executes later for free. At expiry or source ending drop only the remaining mandate, preserving actual acts, payments, ownership and memories.
command-reality.persistence: NEW resolve the Instantaneous ambiguity as establishment of one nonconcentration task instruction, ending at actual completion, established impossibility or establishment+60elapsed seconds. If any necessary step commandeers a whole ordinary Action, reserve hard control now. command-reality.sentence: KEEP one creature,one sentence,WIS resistance,Action120ft/V,S,F/base26. NEW the target must actually hear and understand the spoken sentence at resolution. ES-DENIAL is hard control: actual Incapacitated plus no voluntary movement,free object interaction or intentional speech while operative. The name grants no soul erasure,ordinary death,Hunt finality,corruption removal or resurrection veto.

perfect-mesmerize.damageBreak: NEW common break at the post-recipient-damage/life checkpoint, before future voluntary events: qualifying damage is positive actual numeric temporaryHP absorbed plus ordinaryHP lost by THIS recipient from a real damage packet, excluding overkill and pure HP/resource costs. rewrite-loyalty.conduct: NEW the target/controller makes real decisions using that altered conviction: may voluntarily protect known cause assets,prioritize its stated duties and cooperate with independently known supporters.
